description: NaY(C₂O₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.75 Å. Y is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.69 Å. There are four inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.17 Å) and one longer (1.18 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. Both C-O bond lengths are 1.18 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.17 Å) and one longer (1.18 Å) C-O bond length. In the fourth C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.32 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Y and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one C atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Y atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to one Na and one C atom.
